findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. This condition skips the Claude SDK when `workers = "codex"`. In a repo with `tools = "both"`, `forge close --choice switch` can select Claude for an item (src/forge/close.py:113-114). `forge work` then refuses with `forge doctor --fix` as the next action, but doctor neither reports nor installs the missing SDK.
findings.title: Doctor cannot install the SDK after an item switches to Claude

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. An empty SDK answer reaches the `no_turn` refusal here. Its next action at src/forge/worker.py:58-60 tells the user to run `claude` to answer a prompt. A client using the SDK's bundled executable need not have a separate `claude` command on PATH, so it cannot follow that recovery step.
findings.title: No-turn refusal directs SDK-only clients to a nonexistent Claude command
